summary: Official warnings note that Tipiracil can cause severe myelosuppression, which is a dangerous decrease in blood cell production, requiring regular blood tests [3]. The drug can also cause harm to an unborn baby, posing serious risks during pregnancy [3]. Additionally, a small computer model evaluated the medicine rather than tests on people, estimating low scores of 49 for the liver and 38 for the heart [M].
